job.title: Towards Compute-Aware In-Switch Computing for LLMs Tensor-Parallelism on Multi-GPU Systems
job.selection_reason: HPCA 2026の査読論文。LLM tensor parallelismのcollectiveをcompute memory semanticsへ整合させるCAISを提案し、compute-aware ISA/microarchitecture、thread-block coordination、graph-level overlapを協調設計する。LLM workloadでNVLS solution比平均1.38x、T3比1.61x end-to-end speedupを報告するnetwork/runtime交差候補。
